books.title: The 48 Laws of Power
books.author: Robert Greene
books.blurb: Robert Greene's 48 laws laid out on a chessboard, one square each and sorted into six themes. Open any law for the idea, the book's example and what is worth remembering.

books.title: Animal Farm
books.author: George Orwell
books.blurb: Step through Orwell's ten chapters and watch the farm, and the commandments painted on the barn wall, change. Then meet the characters and the history each one stands for.

books.title: The Art of Seduction
books.author: Robert Greene
books.blurb: Greene's nine seducer characters as a deck of court cards, the eighteen kinds of target, and the twenty-four moves of the process in four phases, each also seen from the receiving end.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.blurb: The compounding curve, the four-step habit loop and the four laws of behaviour change, with a builder that turns them into one habit of your own and a 30-day tracker.

books.title: How to Talk to Anyone
books.author: Leil Lowndes
books.blurb: Nine stops through a conversation, from the first look across the room to the goodbye. Each one draws the scene and opens Lowndes's techniques into a before-and-after exchange you can try today.
